items.raw_excerpt: After years of searching for missing loved ones, Ceci Flores and her daughter obtained government certification recognizing their skills.
items.summary_en: Ceci Flores and her daughter have searched for missing loved ones for years. They now hold a government certificate that recognizes their search skills. No other mother and daughter team has earned this certification in Mexico.
items.summary_ko: 세시 플로레스와 그의 딸은 오랫동안 실종된 가족을 찾아왔다. 두 사람은 이제 수색 기술을 인정하는 정부 인증을 받았다. 멕시코에서 모녀가 함께 이런 인증을 받은 것은 이번이 처음이다.
items.title_en: First mother and daughter who search for missing relatives earn official certification
items.title_ko: 멕시코 처음, 실종 친척을 찾는 오랜 수색자 모녀가 공식 인증 취득
items.title_original: In a first, 2 longtime searchers for missing relatives — mother and daughter — earn official certification

items.raw_excerpt: El cruce entre chilenos por la MLS se disputará en el Estadio Saputo.
items.summary_en: CF Montreal will host Atlanta United in an MLS match. Two Chilean players, Alexis Sanchez and Paulo Diaz, will face each other. The game takes place at Saputo Stadium.
items.summary_ko: CF 몬트리올이 홈구장에서 애틀랜타 유나이티드와 미국 메이저리그사커 경기를 치른다. 칠레 선수 알렉시스 산체스와 파울로 디아스가 맞붙는다. 경기는 사푸토 스타디움에서 열린다.

items.title_original: ¿Cuándo y dónde ver a CF Montreal de Alexis Sánchez ante Atlanta United de Paulo Díaz?

items.raw_excerpt: Locals and preservationists have long opposed Trump's plan to redevelop a municipal D.C. golf course. That legal fight escalated after the government cleared hundreds of trees on short notice.
items.summary_en: A judge blocked the government from clearing trees at a public golf course in Washington, D.C. Locals and preservationists have long opposed plans to redevelop the course. Hundreds of trees were already cleared on short notice.
items.summary_ko: 법원이 워싱턴 D.C. 공공 골프장에서 벌어지는 나무 벌채를 중단시켰다. 지역 주민과 보존 단체는 골프장 재개발 계획에 반대해 왔다. 당국은 판결 전 짧은 시간에 수백 그루의 나무를 이미 베어 냈다.
items.title_en: Judge blocks tree clearing at D.C. golf course

items.raw_excerpt: Having the service more evenly spread across Singapore would give parents options closer to home and reduce travel time, one parent said.
items.summary_en: More than 90 families in Singapore are waiting to be matched with childminders under a pilot program. Having services spread more evenly could give parents options closer to home and cut travel time.

items.raw_excerpt: Batches of popular breakfast cereals Ready Brek Original and Tesco Super Smooth Porridge have been recalled due to the presence of flour beetles.
items.summary_en: Batches of Ready Brek Original and Tesco Super Smooth Porridge have been recalled in Ireland. Flour beetles were found in the cereals. Customers should not eat the affected products.

items.raw_excerpt: Consumer says some households and businesses will face large increases to their electricity lines charges from next year, when the low fixed charge scheme is fully phased out.
items.summary_en: The low fixed charge scheme for power lines will be fully phased out from next year. Consumer NZ says some homes and businesses will face large increases in their electricity lines charges. The poorest households may feel the biggest bill shock.

items.summary_en: Actor Ruaridh Mollica is joining the Marvel universe in the new show VisionQuest. He said he put a scary photo of Paul Bettany on his wall to get ready for the role. Bettany plays the character Vision in Marvel films.
